- Medtronic plc reported first quarter fiscal 2027 results on September 1, 2026, for the quarter ended July 31, 2026. [1]

- In Q1 FY2027, Cardiovascular revenue grew 18.9% organically, led by 15% growth in Cardiac Rhythm Management and 88% growth in Cardiac Ablation Solutions. [1]
- Q1 FY2027 Diabetes business revenue was $843 million, up 16.9% as reported and 14.9% organic. [1]
- Medtronic raised its FY2027 organic revenue growth guidance to 7.25% to 7.75%, an increase from the prior guidance of 6.75% to 7.25%. [1]
- Medtronic raised its FY2027 diluted non-GAAP EPS guidance to the new range of $5.94 to $6.00 versus the prior $5.90 to $6.00, including an estimated neutral to 1% accretive impact from foreign currency exchange based on recent rates. [1]
- MarketBeat reported that Medtronic has set its Q2 FY2027 guidance at $1.320-$1.340 EPS and its FY2027 guidance at $5.940-$6.000 EPS. [2]
- FY2027 is a 53-week fiscal year, with the extra week occurring in the first fiscal month of the first quarter and included in the three months ended July 31, 2026 results. [3]
- Investing.com reported that the extra selling week added about 670 basis points to Q1 FY2027 organic growth, and that excluding that benefit growth was approximately 7%. [4]
- On September 14, 2026, Medtronic commenced an offer to exchange up to 225,361,295 newly issued shares of MiniMed Group, Inc. common stock for outstanding Medtronic ordinary shares, as disclosed in an 8-K filed September 17, 2026. [5]
- Investing.com reported that Medtronic's Q2 FY2027 earnings are scheduled for November 24, 2026, and an Investor Day for December 10-11, 2026. [4]
